events.text:
T-215 stays in review: nothing was left to build, and note F-703a5e07 was already acknowledged by an earlier pass.

- **Videos:** all 18 are on the review index at http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html?v=2e9db5c. Each passes `verify.py` and reads 3840 x 2160 and 59 to 119 seconds from the file.
- **Branch:** `tantra-walkthroughs` is already pushed (2e9db5c, same as origin), so I did not push again.
- **Dodo:** the approved test-mode key was not created, because the recording browser is signed out of the GrowthClub account.
- **Waiting on Adi:** Dodo, Twilio and Google Cloud and Admin keep their docs section until his sign-ins in T-350; nothing merges to main before he approves the videos in T-282.
